references.title: Fourier Neural Operator for Parametric Partial Differential Equations
references.used_for: Operator-learning framing and source-to-solution Poisson/Burgers-style benchmarks.

references.used_for: PDE family selection: Burgers, wave, diffusion-reaction, Allen-Cahn-style transient PDEs.

references.title: Physics-informed neural networks: A deep learning framework for solving forward and inverse problems involving nonlinear partial differential equations
references.used_for: Canonical Burgers, Allen-Cahn and KdV PDE forms; this script uses hard constraints and no BC loss.

references.title: The Zakharov-Kuznetsov equation and multidimensional KdV-type waves
references.used_for: The steady 2D KdV case is treated as a forced ZK/KdV-type equation.

notes: All local HF padding uses replicate, not circular.
Dirichlet boundaries and transient initial conditions are hard projected in the model output.
Training backpropagates normalized PDE residual loss only; absolute PDE residual loss is logged and plotted in the original equation scale.
Exact fields are used for evaluation and plotting, not supervision.
